title: Very simple app. That's why it works so well!
body:
Zero fluff, zero pain. Wish more tracking apps could be like this. 

4 stars due to interface could do with a little TLC.
author: Loy Lee

title: Best tool to keep your daily habits on
body:
The chart function is neat and useful to overview your habits in previous weeks. 

One suggestion is to let me set the number of greens weekly per task rather than just note it with "Skip" because it confuses me when I see the stat normally my "skip" number outweigh my "done" number

author: C1010

title: Useful "habit" app
body: Simple but useful app for forming new habits (or keeping track of how you are doing with breaking old ones!). Found it one of the few apps of its type that I genuine keep up with. Only niggle is that I wish one could customise the 'reminder' for individual habits as some things are done in the mornings and others later in the day/at night. Small thing though and would certainly recommend.
